citations.review_text:
I'm probably not the intended target audience for this game.

I purchased this game to test drive vehicles during a car shopping period. I didn't expect to learn to download additional fan-made content and the insane amount of in-game tweaks to make the game more enjoyable, although I suspect this actually might be a reason why there is such a rabid fanbase for this game.

To further make those test drives more realistic, I actually sprung for a Moza R5 Pro also, which is now the setup to my wife uses to help polish her freeway proficiency. The amount of tinkering and setting up of the game and peripherals this game has players engage in, I believe is a genius calculation. I'm not particularly tech-savvy nor am I a car guy, but I could understand why people would partake in related hobbies and spend thousands of hours making the most minute tweaks for their own satisfaction.

At the price I paid for this game, it's a no-brainer. Looking forward to official sequels.

claims.claim: Reviewers state that the driving physics and force feedback feel realistic and convincing.

citations.review_text:
You buy Assetto Corsa to experience realistic motorsport. Three hours later, you're downloading a 2006 Volkswagen Golf and racing it around Tokyo at 3 AM.

The driving physics are excellent, force feedback feels convincing, and the cars actually behave like cars instead of shopping carts with 900 horsepower.

The modding community is practically keeping an entire automotive universe alive, with countless tracks, vehicles, and visual improvements.

But let's not pretend everything is perfect. The vanilla career is underwhelming, the menus are dated, and getting everything configured can feel like you're preparing a real car for a Formula 1 weekend.

Has it aged well? Exceptionally, thanks to its driving physics and modding community. Without mods, though, its age is much more noticeable.

Ratings:

Driving Physics: 9.5/10

Graphics: 7/10

Content & Modding: 10/10

Accessibility: 6/10

Enjoyment: 9/10

Overall: 9/10 | Recommended
